reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Kansas
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the term 'Execution for possession' used to refer to the order
    from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
*/

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% -------------------------

% The user is asking about whether a specific term is used as the name for
% the court's order directing authorities/process servers to remove a tenant.
scenario_state(kansas).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_asked_term(execution_for_possession).

% This helper succeeds when the factual statement being evaluated is in place.
% (i.e., we are evaluating the meaning/usage of the asked term in this scenario.)
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(kansas),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_asked_term(execution_for_possession).

% -----------------------------------------
% Statute translation: KS Stat  61-3808
% (2021) Writ of restitution
% -----------------------------------------

/*
KS Stat  61-3808 (2021)
(a) If judgment is entered against defendant for possession, court shall issue
    (at plaintiff request) a writ of restitution directing an authorized process
    server named in the writ to place plaintiff in possession.
(b) Executed within 14 days after receipt; reasonable force may be used.
(c) If stayed by appeal, delay execution; if premises restored to plaintiff,
    then immediately place defendant back in possession.
*/

% The statute's name for the instrument/order issued by the court after judgment
% for possession (at plaintiff request).
statute_order_name_for_possession(kansas, 2021, writ_of_restitution).

% The statute describes the writ as directing an authorized person named in the writ
% to place plaintiff in possession (i.e., the operative effect relevant to removal).
statute_order_directs_possession_transfer(kansas, 2021, writ_of_restitution).

% Execution timing rule: executed within 14 days after receipt by the named person.
statute_execution_deadline_days(kansas, 2021, writ_of_restitution, 14).

% The statute expressly allows reasonable force as necessary to execute the writ.
statute_reasonable_force_allowed(kansas, 2021, writ_of_restitution).

% The statute uses the phrase "execution" only as "execution of the writ"
% (not as a separate named order "execution for possession").
statute_uses_word_execution_as_process(kansas, 2021, writ_of_restitution).

% ----------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning helpers: "used to refer to the order"
% ----------------------------------------------------

% A "court order to authorities/process server to remove tenant / restore possession"
% is captured here as the statute-defined order that directs possession transfer.
court_order_to_authorities_for_possession(State, Year, OrderName) :-
    statute_order_name_for_possession(State, Year, OrderName),
    statute_order_directs_possession_transfer(State, Year, OrderName).

% The term is "used to refer to" the order if it matches the statute's name for that order
% OR if there is an explicit statutory alias recorded here.
%
% In this statute, no alias "execution for possession" is provided; the term used is
% "writ of restitution". So we leave aliases empty.
statutory_alias(_State, _Year, _AliasTerm, _CanonicalOrder) :-
    fail.

term_used_to_refer_to_possession_order(State, Year, Term) :-
    court_order_to_authorities_for_possession(State, Year, Term),
    !.
term_used_to_refer_to_possession_order(State, Year, Term) :-
    statutory_alias(State, Year, Term, CanonicalOrder),
    court_order_to_authorities_for_possession(State, Year, CanonicalOrder),
    !.
term_used_to_refer_to_possession_order(_State, _Year, _Term) :-
    fail.

% -------------------------
% housing_answer/1
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_asked_term(Term),
    term_used_to_refer_to_possession_order(State, Year, Term),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main / Entrypoint
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Execution for possession' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
